content: Dotfiles vendor patterns: put upstream in vendor/ via git submodule with pin SHA; personal configs outside; fork+submodule-your-fork when heavily customizing; thin install wrapper inits submodules then runs upstream setup; avoid editing inside submodule without fork. Alternatives: copy-vendor, subtree, chezmoi, Nix. Submodules good for pin/repro; clone needs --recurse-submodules.
